title: PMV installed-environment document, version 1
description: The canonical environment document produced by pmv.reproducibility (stored as runs/<run_id>/environment.json); its SHA-256 is the environment fingerprint recorded in a version 2 execution identity. Documentation only: the authoritative validator is pmv.reproducibility.validate_document. It holds only non-secret reproducibility metadata: no paths, usernames, hostnames, timestamps, or environment-variable values. Canonical bytes: sorted keys, no spaces, ASCII, no floats, one trailing newline. JSON booleans are never integers.

flags.description: The sys.flags values that change how code executes. The PYTHONHASHSEED value itself is never recorded.

distributions.description: Every third-party distribution in the environment, sorted by name, unique. files_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON object {"files": [[path, sha256], ...]} over every RECORD-listed hashed file (sorted by path), excluding bytecode and generated console/GUI-script launchers. Each file's bytes were re-hashed and matched its RECORD digest.

project.description: PMV itself, installed editable. Its path-dependent install metadata is excluded; its code identity is the Git commit and dirty state in the execution identity.
